```yaml
rules:
- id: "vuln-aiohttp-1c335944"
  pattern: |
    if $CONDITION:
        $PATH = $DIRECTORY.joinpath($FILENAME).resolve()
        if not $FOLLOW_SYMLINKS:
            $PATH = $DIRECTORY.joinpath($FILENAME).resolve()
  pattern-not: |
    if $CONDITION:
        $PATH = $DIRECTORY.joinpath($FILENAME)
        if $FOLLOW_SYMLINKS:
            $NORMALIZED = Path(os.path.normpath($PATH))
            $NORMALIZED.relative_to($DIRECTORY)
            $PATH = $NORMALIZED.resolve()
        else:
            $PATH = $PATH.resolve()
  languages: ["python"]
  message: |
    Detected vulnerability in aiohttp static file handling.
    When follow_symlinks=True, directory traversal attacks are possible.
    Fix by normalizing paths before resolution.
  severity: ERROR
  metadata:
    source-url: github.com/aio-libs/aiohttp/commit/1c335944d6a8b1298baf179b7c0b3069f10c514b
    category: security
    cwe: CWE-22
    owasp: A1:2021-Broken Access Control
    references:
      - https://owasp.org/www-project-top-ten/2021/A1_2021-Broken_Access_Control
      - https://www.owasp.org/index.php/Path_Traversal
    technology: [python]
```
